name: Lunatic Fantasy
source: The story starts with an amnesiac woman, who is only able to remember her name - Fab, waking up in the forest. With the help of local dryads Fab reaches a nearby town and stops at the tavern. Suddenly she is approached by a blind girl who proclaims: "Mommy, you finally returned"...
translation: 故事从一个失忆的女人开始，她只记得自己的名字——法布，在森林中醒来。在当地树精的帮助下，法布来到了附近的小镇，在酒馆落脚。突然一个失明的女孩走近她说：“妈妈，你终于回来了……”
